turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so start with who decided that, and on what basis.
Thanks for coming in. The zero went in before I called you, and that was wrong.
I will remove the zero tomorrow morning. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch on Thursday. Nothing goes on his record. I will put all of that in an email to you tonight.
I'm writing down tomorrow morning, Thursday at lunch, and nothing on his record. But a rewrite means you still have a problem with Owen's essay, so what else do you have?
Yes, all of it, in writing tonight.
That's not what I asked, Hale. If there's nothing behind this but a machine's guess, the zero comes off tomorrow morning and there's no rewrite at all.
Okay, I think that is the end of the meeting. Thank you.
I'm still sitting here, Hale. Either you show me what's behind the rewrite, or it's off the table and the zero simply comes off tomorrow morning.
